line: You're new in logistics? Karthik. I test the routing app. If a truck ever tries to drive through the river, that's a bug, and that's my job.

line: Can I ask something? At work I'm 'the Indian guy who knows computers.' At the hall I'm 'Shanthi's son who skips temple.' Where do you get to be just you?
My friends here on work visas are scared to fly home for Pongal. If they leave, they might not get back in. One hasn't seen his mother in three years.
The visa backlog fix passed. My friend Arun got his green card notice after nine years. He bought a car the same day. A minivan. He's single.
